# ATELIER NOIR (15 · atelier)

An architecture practice whose elevations draw themselves — pure line, monochrome, 1:200.

- **Technique:** SELF-DRAWING SVG
- **Tags:** architecture, minimal, monochrome, line art, portfolio, refined, light
- **Best for:** architects; interior designers; portfolios; galleries
- **Fonts:** Bodoni Moda, Figtree
- **Fonts href:** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bodoni+Moda:ital,opsz,wght@0,6..96,400;0,6..96,500;1,6..96,400&family=Figtree:wght@300;400;500&display=swap`
- **Swatch:** #f5f5f2 · #141414 · #9a9a94
- **Dependencies:** none beyond the shared helpers
- **Source:** `src/templates/atelier/` (Template.astro, content.ts, drawings.ts, effects.ts, meta.ts, style.css, theme.css)

## Tokens — `theme.css`
Every color and font stack the design uses. Override per site; canvas/WebGL effects read these at init.

```css
/* atelier — design tokens. Override any of these per site via `theme` (inline on <html>). */
:root {
  --paper: #f5f5f2;
  --paper-hi: #fbfbf9;
  --ink: #141414;
  --ink-soft: #4a4a48;
  --ink-faint: #9a9a94;
  --rule: #dcdcd6;
  /* text on the dark philosophy band */
  --on-ink: #b9b9b2;
  --on-ink-faint: #7a7a74;
  --serif: "Bodoni Moda", serif;
  --sans: "Figtree", sans-serif;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1);
}
```

## Signature effects
- `drawings.ts`
  - `drawingSvg`
- `effects.ts`
  - `initDrawings(svgs: Iterable<SVGElement>)` — Prepare the `.drawable` SVGs for their draw-in animation: every stroke gets its own dash length (`--l`) and a random start delay, and the `drawn` class is added once the drawing is 30% in view.
  - `initWheelScroll(gallery: HTMLElement)` — Let the vertical mouse wheel scroll the gallery sideways, handing the wheel back to the page once the gallery is at either end.

## Content model — `content.ts`
Every user-visible string lives here. Fields ending in `Html` are trusted inline HTML (`<em> <b> <i> <br> <a> <span>`).

```ts
/** Fields ending in `Html` are trusted, author-written HTML (inline <em>/<b>/<i>/<br>/<span>/<a> only). */
export interface Link {
  label: string;
  href: string;
}

/** Which self-drawing line elevation to render. */
export type DrawingKind = 'house' | 'tower' | 'pavilion' | 'chapel' | 'bridge';

export interface Project {
  /** Plate number, e.g. "01". */
  no: string;
  name: string;
  /** Year and place line, e.g. "2024 · BASEL". */
  meta: string;
  description: string;
  drawing: DrawingKind;
}

export interface Content {
  seo: { title: string; description: string; ogTitle?: string; ogDescription?: string };
  /** Wordmark in the nav and footer; wrap the heavier word in `<b>`. */
  wordmarkHtml: string;
  nav: Link[];
  hero: {
    headingHtml: string;
    sub: string;
    /** Figures under the sub line. */
    stats: { value: string; label: string }[];
    drawing: DrawingKind;
    /** Left caption under the hero drawing. */
    figure: string;
    /** Right caption under the hero drawing, e.g. the drawing scale. */
    scale: string;
  };
  work: {
    /** Anchor id of the section head (nav links target it). */
    id: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    /** Hint beside the heading about the sideways-scrolling gallery. */
    hint: string;
    projects: Project[];
  };
  philosophy: {
    id: string;
    quoteHtml: string;
    cite: string;
  };
  practice: {
    id: string;
    columns: { label: string; bodyHtml: string }[];
  };
  footer: {
    note: string;
    /** Credit line; the showcase line is appended on showcase routes. */
    creditHtml: string;
  };
}
```

- Full site: `node <skill-dir>/scripts/weft.mjs template atelier --out <dir>`
- Style kit for an existing project: `node <skill-dir>/scripts/weft.mjs style atelier --out <dir>`
